messages.author: 5ff65f9954c015de
messages.subject: Tech 14 BLRT 2 * LL diff
parts:
Hi there. Is there a way to save the Tech 14 BLRT 2 * LL diff? I see the following:

• BLRT_KM1LL: Log-likelihood of the K-1 model (one less class) for the Bootstrapped Likelihood Ratio Test (TECH14)
• BLRT_PValue: P-value of the Bootstrapped Likelihood Ratio Test (TECH14) testing whether the K class model is
signi cantly better than K-1
• BLRT_Numdraws: The number of bootstrapped samples used in the Bootstrapped Likelihood Ratio Test

but not 2 * Log-likelihood Di erence of K-class vs. K-1-class model

Thank you,
Tait

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Tech 14 BLRT 2 * LL diff
parts:
The LL difference is in the summaries, but was inadvertently left out of the documentation. If you look within the $summaries object for a model extracted by readModels, you should see

BLRT_2xLLDiff: 2x ll diff
BLRT_ParamDiff: difference in number of parameters for k and k-1 models.

Other info about the BLRT is also in the object, which you can see with str(modelObj$summaries)

I'll add these differences to the documentation.

Michael
